svg.text: 2026-11-24 Night Round 9 (Cumulative R796) · Graphify Code+SQL+PDF Graph, Headroom Compression, Context-Mode & Trail-Code
Graphify-Labs/graphify (★152,856) + headroomlabs-ai/headroom (★80,739) + mksglu/context-mode (★34,445) + trailhq/Trail-Code (★11,470)
1. Graphify-Labs/graphify
★ 152,856 · 14.6k forks · Python · Apache-2.0
Unified Code + Docs + SQL + PDF Graph
• Indexes source code, Markdown docs & configs
• Links SQL database schemas & PDF specs
• Exposes queryable knowledge graph (/graphify)
• Bridges code symbols to architecture PDFs
• Eliminates multi-repo cross-artifact blindness
Cross-Modal Codebase Knowledge Graph
2. headroomlabs-ai/headroom
★ 80,739 · 6.3k forks · Python · Apache-2.0
Byte-Exact Signal-Preserving Compressor
• Compresses tool outputs, logs, files & RAG
• Critical FATAL lines survive byte-for-byte
• Saves 20%+ overall tokens for coding agents
• Drop-in middleware before LLM API calls
Lossless-Critical Context Compression
3. mksglu/context-mode
★ 34,445 · 2.3k forks · JavaScript · ELv2
Sandbox + SQLite FTS5 Tool Output Shield
• Supports 11 mainstream coding agents
• Keeps raw tool stdout out of LLM context
• Indexes tool outputs into local SQLite FTS5
• Agent queries only matching snippets on demand
• 100% local execution with zero cloud telemetry
SQLite FTS5 Out-of-Context Tool Buffer
4. trailhq/Trail-Code
★ 11,470 · 1.0k forks · TypeScript · MIT
Call-Graph Map + Pinned Team Learnings
• Indexes every function & caller across repos
• Pins team decisions directly to code nodes
• E.g. "keep retries at 4" attached to caller
• Shared across Claude Code, Cursor & Codex
• Self-learning context layer (formerly graft)
Code-Pinned Team Institutional Memory
Enterprise FinOps & TCO Comparison (45-Engineer Code Intelligence & Context Engineering Team @ $100.00/h · synthetic)
• Path A (Uncompressed 55K-Token Tool Logs + Commercial Code-Search SaaS Seats + Repeated Convention Re-Prompting):
Uncompressed API & Search SaaS $4,890.00/mo + 46.0h Context Overflow & Convention Rework ($4,600.00/mo) = $9,490.00/mo
• Path C (Graphify + Headroom + Context-Mode SQLite FTS5 + Trail-Code Stack):
